## Summary

<!-- Explain the problem and the solution. Keep the pull request focused. -->

## Related issue

<!-- Required: link an existing issue from Development, or use "Closes #123" / "Fixes #123" below when targeting the default branch. A plain issue mention does not create the link checked by "Issue linked". Open an issue first if none exists. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or improvement
- [ ] Documentation or translation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Database, privacy, security, or infrastructure change

## Validation

<!-- List the exact checks you ran and any relevant manual verification. -->

- [ ] `npm run verify` (typecheck, lint, unit tests and build)
- [ ] `npm run test:desktop:all` when relevant

## Screenshots

<!-- Attach screenshots whenever possible: before-and-after images for visible UI changes and reproduction evidence for bug fixes. Use demonstration or public-domain images. Remove only if they are not applicable. -->

## Privacy and data review

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private catalogue content, personal data, unpublished research, or images without permission are included.
- [ ] New network access is explicit, documented, and initiated by the user.
- [ ] Images and records are sent to an AI provider only when the user chooses that provider.
- [ ] Original image files are never modified.
- [ ] Database, backup, and migration effects are documented and tested.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This pull request is written in English and references an existing issue.
- [ ] I attached screenshots whenever possible (before-and-after for UI changes, reproduction evidence for bug fixes).
- [ ] I have read [CLA.md](https://github.com/jorgepb96/nodus-imago/blob/main/CLA.md) and accepted it through the **CLA / signature** check. Every author and coauthor must accept separately; this checkbox alone is not acceptance.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] I updated documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] I added English translations for new static UI text.
- [ ] I added the change to the release notes when it is visible to users.
- [ ] I preserved local-first behavior and existing privacy boundaries.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
